notes.title: Idle Space - MacOS Support & New GUI
notes.content:
Update 1.0.10
[list]
[*] Added: MacOS Support (We now support Windows, Linux, SteamOS and MacOS.)
[*] Added: Power cores can now make salvager drones.
[*] Added: Current, Next and Amounts to purchase info.
[*] Added: New cargo ship variants.
[*] Added: Rework of the GUI back-end.
[*] Added: New menus with a new look.
[*] Added: Tips & Tricks to main menu.
[*] Added: New button layout for the main game screen.
[*] Added: New store layout with better use of screen space.
[*] Added: Replaced the power core menu with the station menu.
[*] Added: Auto-saves every 5 minutes.
[*] Added: 7 new GUI styles to the settings menu.
[*] Added: Ability to change GUI color in the config.
[*] Added: Achievements for mouse clicks.
[*] Added: Restarting in the settings menu will re-launch the game.
[*] Added: Build number to version number to better track issues.
[*] Replaced: All portrait images with better renders.
[*] Replaced: The round progress indicator with a progress bar instead.
[*] Replaced: The default GUI with a new look. (You can still use the original GUI under settings.)
[*] Replaced: Mercenary movement speed 1.2x with increased mercenary shooting speed.
[*] Fix: Reset settings for all configurations prior to 1/15/2021.
[*] Fix: Replace the smoothing function so ships don't "shake".
[*] Fix: 500% performance improvement to GUI.
[*] Fix: Background stars no longer stretch when resizing the screen.
[*] Fix: Hp on enemies wont drop into negatives before they explode.
[*] Fix: Removed a few bugs where crates could bypass the internal object cap of 5000.
[*] Fix: Replaced all instances of the word scrap with crate.
[*] Fix: Removed a few bugs were crates could bypass the internal object cap of 5000.
[*] Fix: Center power cores on cursor when dragging and dropping.
[*] Fix: Adjusted some locale text.
[*] Fix: Adjusted power core colors to match the new GUIs.
[*] Fix: Major optimizations to explosions.
[*] Fix: Gold scrap no longer lags when there is mass amounts of scrap on screen.
[*] Fix: Sound adjustments #2
[/list]
Update 1.0.9
[list]
[*] Added: Resolutions above 1920x1080 have 2x larger GUI.
[/list]
Update 1.0.8
[list]
[*] Fix: Hot swapping dual purple power cores while dual orange power cores are set no longer causes a crash.
[/list]
Update 1.0.7
[list]
[*] Fix: Hide unusable squad sizes.
[*] Fix: Added missing mission notes.
[*] Fix: Bosses no longer become enhanced.
[*] Fix: GUI layout for focus fire buttons.
[*] Fix: Optimized trains so they can no longer be clicked.
[/list]
